title: No school shooting: Sultan Kudarat governor says sound mistaken for gunshot likely due to faulty wiring
summary: Sultan Kudarat Governor Datu Pax Ali Mangudadatu clarified that there was no school shooting incident in the province Wednesday, after loud sounds were mistaken for gunshots at a campus.
